description: This file defines the interface for a text-based commit graph API used in version control visualization, including function declarations for initializing, updating, and displaying commit graphs.

methods.name: graph_setup_line_prefix
methods.description: Sets up the global display of line prefix diff options using a diff_options structure.

methods.name: graph_set_column_colors
methods.description: Configures a custom color scheme for graph columns using an array of color escape strings.

methods.name: graph_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new git_graph structure based on revision info options.

methods.name: graph_clear
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a git_graph structure.

methods.name: graph_update
methods.description: Updates the graph with a new commit, affecting subsequent line output.

methods.name: graph_is_commit_finished
methods.description: Checks if the current commit's graph output is complete.

methods.name: graph_next_line
methods.description: Outputs the next line of the graph into a strbuf, indicating if it contains the current commit.

methods.name: graph_width
methods.description: Returns the current width of the graph in characters.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Prints the entire history graph up to the current commit.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Prints a single line of the history graph.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Prints vertical padding for the graph.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Prints the remaining part of the graph for the current commit.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Prints a commit message and the remaining graph lines to a file handle.
